items.label: One gap for every list of rows

main.title: One gap for every list of rows
main.lead: Why filled rows need space between them, and how one token keeps it everywhere.

items.text: When a list marks the current row with a tint and the row under the pointer with a fill, the two touch. The eye reads one long block, not two rows.
A divider would separate them, but it adds a line to every row at rest. A few pixels of space do the same job and draw nothing.
There should be a gap between items, else the active and hover touch.
items.name: A reviewer

items: Name the role once: the space between rows that carry their own fill.
Let every list of such rows read it.
Change it once and every list follows.
